The record binds projectId, sessionId, nodeKey, attemptRef, current graph revision/hash/epoch, configuration digest and sealed input-manifest digest, and a strict reader rejects any cross-binding mismatch.
Absent, stale, foreign, malformed, noncanonical, ambiguous and unreadable context records return distinct stable codes with exact layers; no UNKNOWN value is replaced by a fabricated digest.

Exact replay returns the original bytes with unchanged raw event/decision counts; conflicting context bytes under one identity refuse before provider invocation and leave zero partial launch/record residue.

Real-Sqlite tests drive the production pre-launch call site, assert exact code/layer, positive hostile-case counts, one accepted control and a mutation where hashing a reference instead of delivered bytes reddens a named assertion.
